thread.title: Dow Set to Tumble as Apple Wrecks Any Chance for a Rally

author: Barron's
title: Dow Set to Tumble as Apple Wrecks Any Chance for a Rally
text:
Illustration by Michael Haddad 6:36 a.m. An Apple ( AAPL ) a day makes the Dow Jones Industrial Average pay, at least these days
After battling back into positive territory on Wednesday, it would have been nice to see the market rally even more on Thursday. Except Apple slashed its guidance after yesterday's close, and its drop-8.8% to $143.97 in pre-open trading-virtually guarantees that won't happen. S&P 500 futures have dropped 1.7%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures have fall 372 points, or 1.6%. Nasdaq Composite futures have tumbled 2.7%.
Apple blamed iPhone sales, primarily in China, for the shortfall, and it would be easy to make a leap from there to global economic weakness. Except that China's Shanghai Composite dipped just 0.04% following the news. That implies that Apple's shortfall might due as much to the trade war between the U.S. and China as it is plain-vanilla economic weakness in the world's second-largest economy .
Either way, it looks ugly for U.S. stocks today.
Write to Ben Levisohn at Ben.Levisohn@barrons.com
